title: Grateful Dead Live at Cumberland County Civic Center on 1982-09-17

ai_review.summary: High‑energy 1982 show with a scorching second set (The Other One, Sugar Magnolia, Morning Dew) captured on a decent audience recording that, while not pristine, conveys the concert’s intensity.
ai_review.review: Fans rave about the electric second set – Phil’s “bombs,” an intense drums/space segment with a Spanish jam, and standout performances of Goin' Down the Road, Eyes & Morning Dew, Sugar Magnolia and The Other One. The recording is an audience capture that lacks the clarity of matrix tapes but still delivers enough presence to feel the night’s power.

ai_rating.rationale: Overwhelmingly positive reviews (most 5‑star) praise the musical performance; recording quality is described as decent but not top‑tier, yielding a high overall rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Not as clear as a matrix or soundboard source; some reviewers note limited fidelity and lack of detail, but the energy and ambience are well captured.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First set described as marginal; second set erupts with intense drums/space, a Spanish jam, and Phil’s explosive bass work leading into several high‑impact songs.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia's vocals are highlighted as moving and his presence felt throughout the show.
band_member_comments.Phil: Multiple mentions of "Phil bombs" and fire‑like bass playing, especially during the second‑set climax.
band_member_comments.Drums: Intense drums/space segment praised for its power.
